items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Like Little Jimmy Scott hired me for – to play with him in Brooklyn when he was working in a club there.

ctx.x: I did have a period where I worked with vocalists that helped me a great deal. Like Little Jimmy Scott hired me for – to play with him in Brooklyn when he was working in a club there. I found that to be real helpful to me. And also Arthur Prysock. I used to play with him sometimes out at the Copa City in Long Island. I just wanted to mention that, because that was kind of an important part of my learning.
What was – what did you learn? Be more specific.

items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Scott used to let me just play all the time behind him

ctx.x: Was working with Jimmy Scott different?
Yeah. Jimmy Scott used to let me just play all the time behind him, because he liked to bend those phrases out of shape anyway. That was a different thing. But I learned from both of them.
Jimmy Scott’s a real interesting phenomenon.
